body:
prod-alert-bot: INCIDENT: High request-error rate (5xx) from inference-edge pool in us-west-2 — paged SRE.

maya: paging — seeing 5xx surge around 16:02 UTC, errors mostly on /v1/generate streaming endpoints. Error % jumped from ~0.2% to ~12% over 3m.

oncall-bot: @maya You are now the primary on-call. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/edge-5xx (auto-ack).

sanjay: I can take triage. Quick question — is this customer-impacting or internal retries?

maya: customer impact: yes, a subset of customers with high fanout (many parallel streaming connections) are hitting token limits / backend OOMs. We are seeing heavy KV cache pressure leading to eviction thrashing.

alex: confirmed logs show repeated gRPC CANCELLED/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED traces tied to a specific model variant (redwood-open-4q).

amelia-sdkg: several of our largest embed/stream customers have opened support tickets saying continuous disconnects. On SDK side, clients are currently retrying immediately and spawning 6 parallel streams per user by default.

maya: mitigation plan (live): 1) apply soft global fanout throttle to reduce parallel streams per API key to 2 (regionally in us-west-2) 2) temporarily reduce default streaming chunk size to lower KV pressure 3) disable experimental streaming_batching feature flag 4) open temporary quota uplift for elite customers if needed

sanjay: agree. I'll apply the throttle via deploy-tool now and patch the routing layer. Command: `robinctl rate-limit set --scope region:us-west-2 --target streaming_parallel_per_key --value 2 --dry-run=false`

alex: I deployed a route rule to divert 10% of traffic to fallback-small (lower-memory variant) as a safety net — fallback will reject gracefully with 429 for new sessions if overloaded.

prod-alert-bot: deploy-bot: rate-limit updated by sanjay at 16:10 UTC.

maya: on client guidance — we need an SDK advisory ASAP: tell customers to add idempotency tokens for non-streaming requests, reduce client-side parallelism, and use exponential backoff with jitter. Also provide a code snippet for recommended retry policy.

amelia-sdkg: drafting message now. Proposed guidance: short, copy-pasteable.

amelia-sdkg: \n```
# Python SDK suggested retry policy (pseudo)
import time, random

def retry_request(fn, max_attempts=5, base_ms=200, max_ms=2000):
    attempt = 0
    while attempt < max_attempts:
        try:
            return fn()
        except TemporaryServerError as e:
            attempt += 1
            sleep_ms = min(max_ms, base_ms * (2 ** (attempt - 1)))
            # full jitter
            time.sleep(random.uniform(0, sleep_ms) / 1000.0)
    raise

# For streaming, limit parallel streams per process to 2 and prefer multiplexing
```

amelia-sdkg: Also include example idempotency header: `Idempotency-Key: <uuid4>` and recommend clients avoid automatic fanout > 2.

maya: Good. Also call out short-term server-side tweak: mark noncritical features (like streaming real-time callbacks) as opt-in by default to avoid automatic activation. Doing that now.

sanjay: I've toggled streaming_batching off in us-west-2 flag-store: `flagctl set streaming_batching us-west-2 false --by oncall` — propagation in ~30s.

alex: I'm watching infra metrics — KV cache hit rate jumped back up slightly after throttles, error rate trending down from 12% -> 4% in 7m.

amelia-sdkg: Drafted customer advisory for support + status page: \n- short description: intermittent streaming disconnects for high-concurrency clients in us-west-2\n- mitigation: regional throttle and temporary disable of streaming_batching; SDK guidance: limit parallel streams, exponential backoff, idempotency keys\n- ETA: monitoring — rolling back mitigations once error rate < 1% for 30m

maya: Who can own SDK patch to put a default client-side knob to cap parallel streams?

amelia-sdkg: I will cut a patch to the Python and JS SDKs — will add a `max_streams_per_key` config defaulting to 2 and backfill docs. Targeting a hotfix release in 90m.

sanjay: Noted. Also opening temporary incident ticket for billing-adjusted quota for impacted customers who get 429s due to mitigation — we'll allow manual uplift until stability.

maya: Ok handoff plan: I'm primary now, but I'll hand to sanjay at 17:00 UTC. Whoever is oncall next, please escalate to platform if we see persistent OOMs after throttles.

alex: quick note for support: tenants impacted (observed) - corpalpha (high fanout), shopmate, devai-inc. Send targeted messages to those accounts with the advisory, reference INC-261234.

amelia-sdkg: Copy for support ticket and status page drafted, ready for review: "We are seeing intermittent streaming interruptions in us-west-2 affecting high-concurrency clients. We have applied a temporary throttle and disabled an experimental optimization. Recommended client changes: reduce parallel streams to 2, implement exponential backoff with jitter, and add Idempotency-Key for non-streaming operations. We will update when error rates normalize."

maya: Thanks. Action items: \n- sanjay: apply/regulate throttle + monitor (in progress)\n- alex: keep fallback routing in place and monitor OOMs\n- amelia-sdkg: publish SDK advisory + patch + support copy (WIP)\n- maya: update incident ticket and status page, coordinate handoff at 17:00 UTC

sanjay: Update: throttle applied, error rate down to 2.1%. Continuing to watch.

oncall-bot: Reminder: please complete post-incident checklist and add postmortem link when created.

maya: handing off to sanjay at 17:00 UTC. Leaving notes in the ticket. :white_check_mark:

sanjay: taking over. Will run 30m stability window before closing incident.

amelia-sdkg: SDK hotfix PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/432 — includes `max_streams_per_key` and retry guidance in README.

maya: Good job team. We'll reconvene in postmortem to cover why streaming_batching caused KV thrash and improve our model variant fallbacks.

alex: +1. Also propose we add a circuit-breaker telemetry signal that can auto-trigger regional throttle at 10% 5xx sustained for 5m.

maya: noted for postmortem. Closing this thread for now; continuing follow-ups in the incident ticket.
